project_type: Node.js backend HTTP service (ecommerce checkout + rewards), single package, no monorepo. Greenfield: be/ currently holds only README.md and .agents/tasks/ docs.
language: TypeScript (strict mode), ESM (package.json type:module), Node.js >= 20 (local toolchain is Node v24.11.0, npm 11.6.1).

key_patterns: Design is in be/.agents/tasks/design.md (authoritative, approved) -- read it. All MUTATIONS (cart add/update/remove, checkout, admin coupon generate) run through ONE SerialExecutor (promise-chain tail; design 4.1); reads are synchronous snapshot builders OFF the executor. Checkout is one serialized executor task = one critical section (design 7.2): key-lookup FIRST, reserve coupon BEFORE inventory validation, decrement+insert+redeem+record on commit only, release coupon on any pre-commit failure. Money is integer cents only; the single percentage division is Math.round half-up then clamp discount to [0, subtotal]. Errors: one AppError{code,httpStatus,message,details?} + a stable ERROR_CODES registry (design Section 11), mapped by a Fastify setErrorHandler; zod failures -> VALIDATION_ERROR 400. Ids: crypto.randomUUID() for cart and order ids (finding 5).
